# Umbra Electric

> Umbra Electric is a Seattle-based premium electric mobility retailer established in 2022, curating high-end electric dirt bikes, e-motos and e-bikes for adults and kids. Umbra Electric ships across the United States, Europe and worldwide, specializing in flagship off-road and trail machines from the brands that define the category. What sets Umbra apart is ruthless curation — only bikes worth owning.

Umbra Electric is headquartered in Seattle, Washington, United States and ships across United States, Europe, Worldwide. Founded 2022.

## Contact

- WhatsApp: [Message us](https://wa.me/10000000000)
- Email: info@umbraelectric.com
- Minimum order: $500 · Free shipping over $2000 · Crypto discount: 10%

## Categories

- [Adult Electric Dirt Bikes](https://umbraelectric.com/shop/adult-electric-dirt-bikes/): 31 models — Full-size, high-power electric dirt bikes and e-motos for adult trail, enduro and motocross riders.
- [Electric Commuter & Urban Bikes](https://umbraelectric.com/shop/electric-commuter-bikes/): 33 models — City, cargo and urban e-bikes built for daily range, comfort and effortless commuting.
- [Electric Fat Tire Bikes](https://umbraelectric.com/shop/electric-fat-tire-bikes/): 6 models — All-terrain fat-tire e-bikes engineered for sand, snow, trail and everything between.
- [Electric Mountain Bikes](https://umbraelectric.com/shop/electric-mountain-bikes/): 27 models — Premium full-suspension eMTBs from the brands that define trail, enduro and downhill riding.
- [Electric Road & Gravel Bikes](https://umbraelectric.com/shop/electric-road-gravel-bikes/): 9 models — Lightweight electric road and gravel bikes for endurance, speed and long-distance riding.
- [Folding E-Bikes](https://umbraelectric.com/shop/folding-electric-bikes/): 6 models — Compact folding e-bikes for apartments, RVs, transit and small-space storage.
- [Kids & Youth E-Bikes](https://umbraelectric.com/shop/kids-electric-bikes/): 8 models — Right-sized, pedal-assist e-bikes that grow young riders' confidence on and off road.
- [Kids & Youth Electric Dirt Bikes](https://umbraelectric.com/shop/kids-electric-dirt-bikes/): 8 models — Youth and teen electric dirt bikes with adjustable, speed-limited power for safe progression.

## Legal

- Most electric dirt bikes are off-highway vehicles — not street-legal without registration, insurance and licensing where required.
